recommended.description: Recommended configuration for abandoned packages, treating packages without a release for 1 year as abandoned, while taking into account community-sourced overrides.

best-practices.description: Preset with best practices from the Renovate maintainers. Recommended for advanced users, who want to follow our best practices.

recommended.description: Recommended configuration for most users. It does not matter what programming language you use.

semverAllMonthly.description: Preserve SemVer ranges and update everything together once a month. (excluding replacements and lockfile maintenance)

semverAllWeekly.description: Preserve SemVer ranges and update everything together once a week (excluding replacements and lockfile maintenance).

azurePipelinesVersions.description: Update `_VERSION` environment variables in Azure Pipelines files.

githubActionsVersions.description: Update `_VERSION` environment variables in GitHub Action files.

gitlabPipelineVersions.description: Update `_VERSION` environment variables in GitLab pipeline file.

valeVersions.description: Update Vale package versions in `.vale.ini` configuration files.

approveMajorUpdates.description: Require Dependency Dashboard approval for `major` updates.

assignAndReview.description: Set `{{arg0}}` as assignee and reviewer of PRs.

automergeAll.description: Automerge all upgrades (including `major`) if they pass tests.

automergeBranch.description: If automerging, push the new commit directly to the base branch (no PR).

automergeDigest.description: Automerge `digest` upgrades if they pass tests.

automergeDisabled.description: Disable automerging feature - wait for humans to merge all PRs.

automergeLinters.description: Update lint packages automatically if tests pass.

automergeMajor.description: Automerge all upgrades (including `major`) if they pass tests.

automergeMinor.description: Automerge `patch` and `minor` upgrades if they pass tests.

automergePatch.description: Automerge `patch` upgrades if they pass tests.

automergePr.description: Raise a PR first before any automerging.

automergeRequireAllStatusChecks.description: Require all status checks to pass before any automerging.

automergeStableNonMajor.description: Automerge non-major upgrades for semver stable packages if they pass tests.

automergeTesters.description: Update testing packages automatically if tests pass.

automergeTypes.description: Update `@types/*` packages automatically if tests pass.

combinePatchMinorReleases.description: Do not separate `patch` and `minor` upgrades into separate PRs for the same dependency.

configMigration.description: Enable Renovate configuration migration PRs when needed.

dependencyDashboardApproval.description: Enable Renovate Dependency Dashboard approval workflow.

disableDomain.description: Disable requests to a particular domain.

disableHost.description: Disable requests to a particular host.

disablePrControls.description: Remove the checkbox controls from PRs.

disableRateLimiting.description: Remove hourly and concurrent rate limits.

enableVulnerabilityAlerts.description: Raise PR when vulnerability alerts are detected.

enableVulnerabilityAlertsWithAdditionalL.description: Raise PR when vulnerability alerts are detected with label `{{arg0}}`, in addition to any existing list of PR labels.

enableVulnerabilityAlertsWithLabel.description: Raise PR when vulnerability alerts are detected with label `{{arg0}}`, replacing any existing list of PR labels.

followTag.description: For package `{{arg0}}`, strictly follow release tag `{{arg1}}`.

githubComToken.description: Use provided token for `github.com` lookups. Do not configure this if you are already running on `github.com`.

ignoreModulesAndTests.description: Ignore `node_modules`, `bower_components`, `vendor` and various test/tests (except for nuget) directories.

ignoreUnstable.description: Upgrade to unstable versions only if the existing version is unstable.

includeNodeModules.description: Include `package.json` files found within `node_modules` folders or `bower_components`.

maintainLockFilesDisabled.description: Update existing lock files only when `package.json` is modified.

maintainLockFilesMonthly.description: Run lock file maintenance (updates) on the first day of each month.

maintainLockFilesWeekly.description: Run lock file maintenance (updates) early Monday mornings.

pathSemanticCommitType.description: Use semanticCommitType `{{arg1}}` for all package files matching path `{{arg0}}`.

pinDependencies.description: Pin dependency versions where `depType=dependencies`. Usually applies only to non-dev dependencies in `package.json`.

pinDevDependencies.description: Pin dependency versions for development dependencies.

pinDigestsDisabled.description:
Disable pinning of dependency digests.

Note: This preset does not revert the digest pinning set from within the packageRules, when set at root level or via extends).
See [Docker - Disable digest pinning](./docker.md#disable-digest-pinning) for more details.

pinOnlyDevDependencies.description: Pin dependency versions for development dependencies and retain SemVer ranges for others.

pinSkipCi.description: Add `[skip ci]` to commit message body whenever pinning.

pinVersions.description: Use version pinning (maintain a single version only and not SemVer ranges).

prConcurrentLimit10.description: Limit to maximum 10 open PRs at any time.

prConcurrentLimit20.description: Limit to maximum 20 open PRs at any time.

prConcurrentLimitNone.description: Remove limit for open PRs at any time.

preserveSemverRanges.description: Preserve (but continue to upgrade) any existing SemVer ranges.

prHourlyLimit1.description: Rate limit PR creation to a maximum of one per hour.

prHourlyLimit2.description: Rate limit PR creation to a maximum of two per hour.

prHourlyLimit4.description: Rate limit PR creation to a maximum of four per hour.

prHourlyLimitNone.description: Removes rate limit for PR creation per hour.

prImmediately.description: Raise PRs immediately (after branch is created).

prNotPending.description: Wait for branch tests to pass or fail before creating the PR.

rebaseStalePrs.description: Rebase existing PRs any time the base branch has been updated.

renovatePrefix.description: Add the `renovate/` prefix to all branch names.

respectLatest.description: Upgrade versions up to the "latest" tag in the npm registry.

semanticCommits.description: Use semantic prefixes for commit messages and PR titles.

semanticCommitScope.description: Use semantic commit scope `{{arg0}}` for all commits and PR titles.

semanticCommitScopeDisabled.description: Disable semantic commit scope for all commits and PR titles.

semanticCommitsDisabled.description: Disable semantic prefixes for commit messages and PR titles.

semanticCommitType.description: Use `{{arg0}}` as semantic commit type for commit messages and PR titles.

semanticCommitTypeAll.description: If Renovate detects semantic commits, it will use semantic commit type `{{arg0}}` for all commits.

semanticPrefixChore.description: Use `chore` as semantic commit type for commit messages and PR titles.

semanticPrefixFix.description: Use `fix` as semantic commit type for commit messages and PR titles.

semanticPrefixFixDepsChoreOthers.description: Use semantic commit type `fix` for dependencies and `chore` for all others if semantic commits are in use.

separateMajorReleases.description: Separate `major` versions of dependencies into individual branches/PRs.

separateMultipleMajorReleases.description: Separate each `major` version of dependencies into individual branches/PRs.

separateMultipleMinorReleases.description: Separate each `minor` version of dependencies into individual branches/PRs.

separatePatchReleases.description: Separate `patch` and `minor` releases of dependencies into separate PRs.

skipStatusChecks.description: Skip status checks and automerge right away.

updateNotScheduled.description: Keep existing branches updated even when not scheduled.

widenPeerDependencies.description: Always widen `peerDependencies` SemVer ranges when updating, instead of replacing.

safeEnv.description: Hopefully safe environment variables to allow users to configure.

allApollographql.description: Group all packages published by Apollo GraphQL together.

apiPlatform.description: Group PHP API Platform packages together.

fortawesome.description: Group all packages by Font Awesome together.

gradle.description: Group anything that looks like Gradle together so that it's updated together.

jekyllEcosystem.description: Group Jekyll and related Ruby packages together.

jsTestNonMajor.description: Group non-major JS test package updates together.

jsUnitTest.description: Group JavaScript unit test packages together.

jsUnitTestNonMajor.description: Group JavaScipt unit test packages together for non-major updates.

nodeJs.description: Group anything that looks like Node.js together so that it's updated together.

nodeJsWithTypes.description: Group Node.js runtime updates together with `@types/node`.

packageRules.description: Group Pulumi Node.JS packages together.
Group Pulumi Python packages together.
Group Pulumi Go packages together.
Group Pulumi Java packages together.
Group Pulumi .NET packages together.

react.description: Group React and corresponding `@types` packages together.

recommended.overrideDescription: Use curated list of recommended non-monorepo package groupings.

rubyOnRails.description: Group Ruby on Rails packages together.

springRestDocs.description: Group Java Spring REST Docs packages.

testNonMajor.description: Group all non-major test package updates together.

unitTest.description: Group all unit test packages together.

unitTestNonMajor.description: Group all unit test packages together for non-major updates.

vite.description: Group all Vite related packages together.

vitePlus.description: Group all Vite+ related packages together.

minimumReleaseAgeCrate.description: Wait until the Crate version is three days old before raising the update. This a) introduces a short delay to allow for malware researchers and scanners to (possibly) detect any malicious behaviour in crates, and b) reduces the risk of upgrading to a newly published crate that its owner deletes during crates.io's initial 72-hour deletion window.

packageRules.description: Do not require Minimum Release Age for update types that are controlled by the package manager
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Renovate's lock file maintenance functionality does not support validating Minimum Release Age, as the package manager performs the required changes to update package(s). Confirm whether your package manager perform its own validation for the Minimum Release Age of packages.

packageRules.description: Do not require Minimum Release Age for package replacements
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Renovate's replacement functionality [does not currently](https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/issues/39400) wire in the release age for a package, so the Minimum Release Age checks can apply. You will need to manually validate the Minimum Release Age for these package(s).

packageRules.description: Do not require Minimum Release Age for update types that do not provide a release timestamp
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Renovate does not enforce Minimum Release Age for `bump`, `lockfileUpdate`, or `rollback` updates, so these are raised without a Minimum Release Age check. You will need to manually validate the Minimum Release Age for these package(s).
